title: Urugendo rw'Umutima Warezwe
intro: Mu gihe amategeko y’ikibano yari afise ububasha, umuntu yihariye yarahindutse cane mu rugo rwahezagiwe. Inkuru yabo, irangwa n’urukundo rwinshi be n’itegeko ry’Imana, yerekana ukuntu imigenzo ya kera yacitsemwo ibice be n’ukuntu hashirwaho ingingo ngenderwako nshasha zigororotse. Iyi nkuru irashira ahabona akamaro k’ukuri kuruta amasezerano n’ubwenge buri inyuma y’amabwirizwa ya Allah.
clues: Narigeze kuba imbohe, mugabo biciye ku ntunganyo y’Imana, nararonse inzu n’umuryango mushasha.
Nari nkundwa cane ku buryo igihe nahabwa amahitamwo hagati y’umuryango wanje w’amavuko n’uwo nareze, nahisemwo kuguma n’uwo wa nyuma.
Izina ryanje ryari risanzwe rifatanywa n’uwo nari narareze, ivyo bikaba ari ibintu vyari bimenyerewe mu kibano canje.
Ndi jenyene umugenzi w’Umuhanuzi wa nyuma izina ryiwe rivugwa mu buryo butomoye na Allah muri Korowani.
Narongoye umugore w’icubahiro yari muvyara w’Umuhanuzi, ariko ubugeni bwacu ntibwaramaze igihe kirekire.
Inyuma y’aho ntandukaniye n’umugabo wanje, Allah ubwiwe yategetse ko uwo nari nararongoye azorongora Nkurunziza, gutyo bica bikuraho umugenzo wa kera werekeye ukurera umwana.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
